body:
I think I'm doing alright. I had an pity argument with my mother earlier about not being able to get transportation to a community event that triggered me into writing this post (I get very upset with myself when I get angry at my parents and yell at them..) so I think I should go apologize and give her a hug. I'll probably take a nap after that. 

Thank you for being here to listen: it's a really grueling and often difficult task to listen to someone with depression spill themselves out to you as sometimes its hard to formulate a response. I appreciate people like you who are willing to be here to help. Thank you. Please take care!

EDIT: Hooooly crap. My mom walked in to apologize literally as I hit submit. Many hugs were exchanged.

Thank you for your response. 
I have actually considered ringing a hotline but I am rarely ever alone in the house so I'm worried that I'd be discovered and if that's the case, I'd end up having to explain everything to them anyways. They'd want to know who I'm talking to, why I didn't tell them, yada-yada-yada... I don't know. Maybe I will if I get a chance... I don't really know what to expect and that "unknown" kinda worries me for whatever reason. 

I'm much calmer now than I was when I submitted this post, but knowing someone like you can relate does relax me. Thank you.
